Main Services

  • 01
    Manufacturing Quality Control
    Manufacturing inspection of materials and equipment to verify compliance with project requirements, specifications and applicable standards at vendor’s workshop
  • 02
    Pre-shipment Inspection
    Independent pre-shipment inspection of cargo, equipment and materials of conformity to quality standards, quantity and specification
  • 03
    Construction Supervision
    Technical supervision of construction and installation works including quality process control, verification of scope of performed works, and compliance with design documentation and applicable codes and standards
  • 04
    Energy Facilities Inspection
    (Power Generation & Renewables)
    Inspection of energy facilities equipment and infrastructure to ensure compliance with technical requirements, safety standards, and operational reliability. Analysis of site’s power potential
  • 05
    Outsourcing
    Supply chain management for equipment and materials (including project management, QA/QC, expediting, logistics and warehouse management)
  • 06
    Non-Destructive Testing
    (NDT) Laboratory
    Non-destructive testing is performed to confirm the safety and efficient operation of your equipment by detecting defects before they result in severe damage
